blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We propose BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design. Given a prompt, an agent is tasked with producing an assembly that not only satisfies semantic and design criteria, but that can also be physically built. To do so, it must select parts from a discrete library and reason jointly about local and global constraints. We score validity, alignment, and design across three settings that vary in scale and part availability. We provide BrickAgent, an environment for coding agents to construct, inspect, and validate their designs. We find that leading agents largely satisfy verifiable physical and semantic requirements, but fall short of human designs. We release our benchmark and environment at http://www.brickben.ch
blocks.zh: 我们提出Brick Bench, 一个具有代理文本条件的LEGO设定设计的基准. 迅速,代理人负责制作一个不仅符合语义和设计标准,而且可以实际建造的组件。 为此,它必须从独立的图书馆中选择部分内容,并就地方和全球制约因素共同提出理由。 我们通过三种不同规模和部分可用性的设置来获得有效性、一致性和设计。 我们提供BrickAgent, 一种环境 编码代理 建造,检查和验证他们的设计。 我们发现,领先的物剂基本上满足了可核查的物理和语义要求,但是没有达到人类的设计. 我们在http://www.brickben.ch上公布了我们的基准和环境。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Designing a LEGO assembly is deceptively difficult.
A designer must select from thousands of parts, arrange them into a recognizable form, and ensure that the structure holds together.
Computational generative approaches to brick assembly have relied on specialized models and carefully engineered representations to handle these challenges ( Chung et al., 2021 ; Pun et al., 2025 ; Kulits & Schmid, 2026 ) .
But coding agents offer a different approach: they can write programs, execute them, inspect the results, and revise.
This shift is already transforming software engineering ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , graphics ( Gu et al., 2025 ) , and CAD ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
We find that a general coding agent, without task-specific training, substantially outperforms specialized LEGO-generation models on the BrickNet benchmark ( Kulits & Schmid, 2026 ) , approaching the semantic alignment of its reference assemblies ( Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
设计一个LEGO组装在欺骗上是困难的.
设计师必须从上千个部件中选择,将它们安排成可识别的形式,并确保结构在一起.
对砖块组装的计算基因方法依靠专门模型和精心设计的表述来应对这些挑战(Chung等人,2021;Pun等人,2025;Kulits & Schmid,2026)。
但编码代理提供不同的方法:他们可以编写程序,执行程序,检查结果,并修改程序.
这种转变已经在改变软件工程(Jimenez等,2024年),图形 (Gu等,2025年),和CAD(张等,2026年).
我们发现,一个一般的编码代理人,在没有具体任务培训的情况下,在BrickNet基准(Kulits & Schmid, 2026年)上大大超过专业的LEGO生成模型,接近其参考组件的语义相接(图2)。

blocks.en:
Yet does this mean agents have learned to design LEGO?
Existing evaluations leave two important challenges unexplored.
First, physical complexity: BrickNet evaluates small objects of at most 100 parts, far from the hundreds or thousands of interconnected pieces and inventory constraints of a full LEGO set.
Second, and more fundamentally, design quality: making an assembly that works is not the same as making an assembly worth building.
The appeal of LEGO lies not merely in reproducing an object, but in the creativity of its construction: clever part usage, shapes, proportions, and details.
Two builds can be equally valid and faithful to a description, yet differ dramatically in how well they are designed.
Unlike physical validity or semantic alignment with a prompt, design quality has no definitive pass/fail test.
blocks.zh:
这是否意味着特工们学会了设计LEGO?
现有的评价使两个重大挑战没有得到探讨。
首先,物理复杂性:BrickNet对最多100个部分的小物体进行评价,远非LEGO全集的上百个或上千个互相连接的块和清单限制.
第二,更根本的是,设计质量:制作一个能起作用的集合与制作一个值得建造的集合是不一样的.
LEGO的吸引力不仅在于复制一个物体,还在于其构造的创造性:聪明的部分使用,形状,比例和细节.
两座建筑同样有效并忠实于一种描述,但在设计上却大相径庭。
与物理有效性或语义上与即时的对接不同,设计质量没有确定的通过/失败测试.

blocks.en:
We introduce BrickBench , a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design ( Fig. 1 ).
BrickBench contains 300 prompts across three settings: Model (at most 400 parts), Set (400–4000 parts), and Alt-Build (a fixed inventory of parts).
To support complex construction, we introduce BrickAgent , an environment for agentic LEGO design including construction tools and interpretable validation of connectivity, collisions, and stability.
Rather than prescribing how to design an assembly, BrickAgent provides the building blocks, constraints, and feedback, leaving the agent to devise its own solution.
To evaluate what validity and semantic alignment miss, we measure design quality through pairwise judgments, validated against human preferences.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Brick Bench, 即具有代理文本条件的LEGO设定设计的基准(图1)。
Brick Bench包含由三个设置组成的300个提示:Model(最多400个部件),Set(400–4000个部件)和Alt-Build(固定的零件库存).
为了支持复杂的建筑,我们引入了BrickAgent(BrickAgent),这是一个代理LEGO设计的环境,包括建筑工具和可解释的验证连接、相撞和稳定性。
BrickAgent没有规定如何设计一个组装,而是提供构件,约束和反馈,任由代理设计出自己的解决方案.
为了评估哪些有效性和语义校正错失,我们通过对等判断来衡量设计质量,对照人类偏好加以验证。

blocks.en:
We evaluate eleven frontier agents and two data-driven baselines.
With BrickAgent, leading agents produce valid assemblies for nearly every prompt, and the best satisfies approximately 95% of semantic requirements.
Removing the environment sharply reduces physical validity, showing that reliable construction depends on grounded tools and feedback.
Design quality, however, separates agents far more strongly, and human raters identify human-designed assemblies in 323 of 360 comparisons.
These findings reveal a shift in the challenge of LEGO design: Agents are learning to build what works, but not yet what makes a great design.
blocks.zh:
我们评估了11个边界代理人和两个数据驱动基线。
与BrickAgent公司,领先的代理公司几乎每一次快速生产有效的组件,最佳能满足大约95%的语义要求.
消除环境会大幅降低物理有效性,表明可靠的构造依赖于有根据的工具和反馈.
然而,设计质量将物剂分离得更强烈,人类测评员在360个比较中的323个中识别出由人类设计的集合.
这些发现揭示了LEGO设计挑战的转变: 特工们正在学习建造什么是可行的, 但不是什么是伟大的设计。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. 1. BrickBench , a benchmark of 300 prompts in three settings for agentic brick design, with metrics for physical validity (connections, collisions, and stability under simulation), semantic alignment ( VQA , over yes/no questions decomposed from each prompt), and design quality ( ELO , from pairwise judgments by a VLM validated against human raters). 2. BrickAgent , an environment enabling coding agents to programmatically construct, inspect, and validate complex LEGO assemblies, with part search, placement by connectors, subassemblies, rendering, and a validator that names parts at fault. Without it, the share of valid assemblies falls from 100% to 40% for GPT-6 Astra and to under 1% for GPT-5.6 Luna. 3. A systematic evaluation of eleven frontier agents and two data-driven baselines, with human studies that validate the design metric and measure the gap to human design.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Agentic Benchmarks. Benchmarks for coding agents validate an agent’s work by executing it.
SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) runs a repository’s tests on a patch an agent supplied, and OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) tracks state through execution.
SceneCraft ( Hu et al., 2024 ) writes Blender scripts, and CAD-Assistant ( Mallis et al., 2025 ) writes CAD programs.
Benchmarks then execute the program and score the result.
BlenderGym ( Gu et al., 2025 ) compares the result with a goal scene, and BenchCAD ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) executes CadQuery programs for industrial parts.
BuildArena ( Xia et al., 2026 ) scores machines assembled from modular parts by their simulated behavior, and PhyBlock ( Ma et al., 2025 ) scores block placements for plausibility in a physics simulator.
BrickBench executes the agent’s program into an assembly of real LEGO parts and validates connections, collisions, and stability under simulation.
blocks.zh:
代理基准。 编码代理人的基准通过执行验证代理人的工作。
SWE-bench(Jimenez等, 2024年)在提供代理的补丁上运行了寄存器的测试, OSWorld(Xie等, 2024年)通过执行跟踪状态.
SceneCraft(Hu等,2024年)撰写了Blender脚本,而CAD-Apple(Mallis等,2025年)撰写了CAD程序.
基准然后执行程序并得分结果.
BlenderGym(Gu等,2025年)将结果与入球场相提并论,BeningCAD(Zhang等,2026年)为工业零件执行CadQuery方案.
BuildArena (Xia等,2026年)通过模拟行为从模块部件组装出分数的机器,而PhyBlock (Ma等,2025年) 将分数块放置在一个物理模拟器中,以表示可信度.
Brick Bench 将代理程序执行成真正的LEGO部件组装,并在模拟下验证连接、碰撞和稳定性。

blocks.en:
LEGO and Evaluation. Prior work generates LEGO assemblies with learned models and uses LEGO tasks to evaluate others.
BrickGPT ( Pun et al., 2025 ) fine-tunes a language model to place eight brick types on a 20 × 20 × 20 20{\times}20{\times}20 grid from a caption.
BrickNet ( Kulits & Schmid, 2026 ) , predicts connections rather than positions and autoregressively generates structures through typed connectors.
LEGO-Maker ( Ge et al., 2025 ) produces building facades conditioned on an image.
Other work evaluates agents and multimodal models on LEGO tasks.
Break and Make ( Walsman et al., 2022 ) gives an agent an LDraw model in a simulator to test whether it can inspect it, take it apart, and rebuild it from scratch.
LEGO-Puzzles ( Tang et al., 2026 ) presents multimodal models spatial questions about assembly steps.
BrickBench does both: general coding agents generate set-scale assemblies from a text prompt, while we score the assemblies on physical validity, prompt alignment, and design.

其他工作是对专家组任务的代理人和多模式进行评价。
Break and Make (Walsman等,2022年)在模拟器中给一剂LDraw模型来测试它是否能够检查,拆分并从头重建.

Brick Bench 两者兼而有之:一般的编码代理从文本提示中生成自定义的组件,而我们则根据物理有效性、即时对齐和设计对组件进行评分。

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: 3.1 LDraw
blocks.zh: 3.1 长线

blocks.en:
LDraw is a community-maintained part library and standard for digital LEGO modeling 1 1 1 https://www.ldraw.org .
Each library part is intended to mirror a real-world counter-part.
Assemblies are represented as text files of instances defined by their part type, color, and 6D pose.
LDraw does not itself, however, determine whether an assembly holds together or could be built.
blocks.zh:
LDraw是一个社区维护的部分库和数字LEGO模型的标准,用于11 1 https://www.ldraw.org.
每个图书馆部分都是为了反映一个真实世界的对应部分.
Assembly是按其部分类型、颜色和6D姿势定义的实例的文本文件。
然而,LDraw本身并不决定一个会场是合并的还是可以建造的.

blocks.en: 3.2 Connectivity and Physical Validity
blocks.zh: 3.2 连通性和物理有效性

blocks.en:
BrickNet ( Kulits & Schmid, 2026 ) annotates each part in the LDraw library with typed connectors.
Each connector instance has a type, a subtype, a polarity, and a frame.
The subtype names the connector’s geometry within its type and fixes what it mates with: a stud mates with a hole or a tube, and a bar with a clip.
The polarity distinguishes the two halves of a hinge, ball, or fixed joint, which must be opposite to connect.
The frame is the connector’s position and orientation in the coordinates of its part, with one axis along the direction of mating.
Two part instances are connected when a compatible pair of their connectors is aligned up to tolerance.
blocks.zh:
BrickNet (Kulits & Schmid, 2026) 将 LDraw 库中的每个部分都以打入的连接器进行注释.
每个连接器实例都有一个类型,一个子类型,一个极性,和一个框架.
子类型将连接器的几何命名在其类型中,并修正它与它交配的内容:有孔或管子的螺旋配对,有剪辑的栏杆。
极性区别于一个支链,球,或固定关节的两相半,它们必须相向相接.
框架是连接器在其部分坐标上的位置和取向,沿交配方向有一个轴.
当一对相容的连接器对齐到容能时,有两个部分的连接.

blocks.en:
There are five connector types.
A stud connector allows rotation about the connection axis, a hinge allows rotation and a possible flip, and an axle additionally allows a slide along its axis.
A ball allows free rotation, and a fixed-type connector allows no motion.
blocks.zh:
有5个连接器类型.
一个螺旋连接器允许围绕连接轴旋转,一个链条允许旋转和可能的翻转,而轴还允许沿它的轴滑行.
一个球允许自由自转,而固定型连接器则不允许运动.

blocks.en:
The connections between instances of an assembly form a graph over parts.
An assembly may have more than one component to represent a scene with multiple (disconnected) objects.
We define an assembly as stable if it remains at rest under gravity.
We treat connected components as rigid bodies of the assembly and simulate them as single rigid bodies of uniform density in PyBullet ( Coumans & Bai, 2016–2021 ) .
We set a high coefficient of friction and no restitution, so that inter-component contacts neither slide nor bounce.
A component then fails by falling when it is not supported.
We consider an assembly stable if no point of any component moves more than three quarters the height of the stud of a brick, 3 LDraw Units (LDU).
Effects such as the holding force of stud connections and the play of axles are not modeled, so an assembly that balances as a rigid body passes even when a built one might sag or fall apart.
Evaluating this would require a structural simulation, with either a force limit at each connection or a finite-element model of the parts, which we discuss in Sec. 6 .
Two parts collide when their geometry overlaps by more than a tolerance.
An assembly with collisions cannot be built, and is determined invalid prior to simulation.
blocks.zh:
组合实例之间的连接构成一个图来覆盖各个部分。
一个集合可能有一个以上的组件来代表一个有多个(已断开)对象的场景.
我们把集合定义为稳定,如果它处于重力状态。
在PyBullet(Coumans & Bai,2016–2021)中,我们把相连的部件当作装配的刚性活体,并模拟成单一的刚性活体。
我们设定了高的摩擦系数,没有还原,这样元件间接触就不会滑动或回弹.
一个组件在不支持时会下降而失效 。
我们认为,如果任何部件的分点都不超过砖块高地四分之三,即3个LDDU,则组装是稳定的。
诸如柱状连接的牵引力和轴心的打法等效果没有被模拟,所以即使一个被建成的物体可能会被割裂或分崩离析时,一个平衡为刚性身体的组装也会通过.
评估这一点将需要一种结构模拟,在每次连接时都设定出力限,或者对部件设定一个有限要素模型,我们在第6节中对此进行了讨论。
当它们的几何相重叠时,两部分会相撞,它们之间的相重叠不仅限于相容性.
与相撞相撞的集合无法被构建,在模拟之前被确定为无效.

In text-conditioned assembly, a system receives a text prompt and is tasked with producing an assembly that depicts it.
The system must select part types from the library and assign each instance a color, position, and 3D rotation.
blocks.zh:
在有文字条件的组装中,一个系统收到一个文本提示并负责生成一个描述它的组装.
系统必须从库中选择部分类型并指定每个实例的颜色,位置和3D旋转.

blocks.en:
Prior work BrickNet trains a language model for this task on human-designed assemblies collected from online.
Its captions are generated by a vision–language model over renders of existing assemblies.
The validation set contains 512 such held-out captions from single objects of at most 100 parts each.

其标题是由视觉-语言模式生成的,而不是现有集会。
验证集包含来自单个对象的512个此类被搁置标题,每个对象最多100个部分。

The agent is given the environment described in Sec. 4.3 .
To match BrickNet, we limit the agent to 100 parts.
An output is scored by the alignment between its renders and the prompt, measured with PE ( Bolya et al., 2025 ) , SigLIP 2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , and VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) .

用PE(Bolya等人,2025年),SigLIP测量的产量与产量之间的比例一致,得出产出的分数。 2 (Tschannn等,2025年),和VQAScore(Lin等,2024年).

blocks.en:
Without having been trained on the dataset, the agent substantially outperforms task-specific baselines BrickNet and BrickGPT ( Pun et al., 2025 ) , scoring within 0.02 of the held-out (GT) assemblies on each metric and effectively saturating the evaluation.
This motivates our design of a new benchmark.
blocks.zh:
该剂在未接受过数据集培训的情况下,大大超过任务特定基线BrickNet和BrickGPT(Pun等人,2025年),在被搁置的(GT)组件中,在0.02分内对每分量进行有效饱和评价。
这促使我们设计出一个新的基准。

blocks.en: 4 BrickBench
blocks.zh: 4个 Brick Bench

blocks.en:
BrickBench is a benchmark of agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design.
Given a text prompt, an agent must produce an assembly that satisfies semantic and design criteria and that can be physically built.
The benchmark consists of 300 prompts in three settings ( Sec. 4.1 ), an environment in which a coding agent can build, and an evaluation protocol for validity, semantic alignment, and design quality ( Sec. 4.4 ).
Except for the ablation in Sec. 5.2 and the two data-driven baselines, the agents work inside of the BrickAgent environment described in Sec. 4.3 .
blocks.zh:
Brick Bench是代理文本条件LEGO-set设计的基准.
鉴于文字提示,代理人必须产生一个符合语义和设计标准并能实际建造的集合.
基准由三处设置的300个提示(Sec 4.1 )组成,这是编码代理能够构建的环境,也是关于有效性,语义相配和设计质量的评价协议(Sec 4.4 ).
除了Sec. 5.2中的衰竭和两个由数据驱动的基线外,这些剂在Sec. 4.3所描述的BrickAgent环境中工作.

blocks.en: 4.1 Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
The settings differ in the parts that an agent builds with.
In the Model setting, an agent may use at most 400 parts, while the Set setting requires 400–4000 parts be used.
Both draw from the full LDraw library as supported by BrickNet, 14,441 part types.
In the Alt-Build setting, an agent may use only the 783 pieces, of 104 part types, of the retail set 10698, 2 2 2 https://www.bricklink.com/v2/catalog/catalogitem.page?S=10698 containing mostly basic bricks and plates with a few windows, doors, wheels, and decorative elements.
An assembly that violates these limits fails the validity check.
blocks.zh:
代理构建的部分设置不同。
在模型设定中,一个代理最多可以使用400个部件,而Set设定则需要使用400–4000个部件.
两者均取自由BrickNet支持的全LDraw库,14,441个部分类型.
在Alt-Build设定中,一个代理可能只使用零售机10698, 2 2 2 的783个部件,共104个部分类型 https://www.bricklink.com/v2/catalog/catalogitem.page?S=10698 包含多为基础砖和板材,并有几扇窗子,门,车轮,和装饰元素.
违反这些限制的组装不能进行有效性检查。

blocks.en: The settings are intended to evaluate different abilities. Model serves as the base evaluation and tests the creation of assemblies consisting primarily of a single component. Set , whose size is chosen to mirror the requirements of the BrickLink Designer Program, 3 3 3 https://www.bricklink.com/v3/designer-program/main.page tests whether an agent can build an assembly on the scale of a full-size retail set. Alt-Build evaluates agent ability to design given a scarce, fixed part inventory.
blocks.zh: 设置旨在评价不同的能力。 模型作为基础评估和测试主要由单一组成部分组成的集会的建立。 set.,其大小被选择来反映"BrickLink Designer"程序的要求,3 3 3 https://www.bricklink.com/v3/designer-program/main.page测试代理商是否能够在全尺寸零售集的规模上构建一个集合. Alt-Build评价了代理人设计能力,提供了稀有的固定部分库存。

blocks.en: 4.2 Prompts
blocks.zh: 4.2 提示

blocks.en:
Each evaluation setting has 100 prompts, with ten in each of ten topic categories.
They follow the BrickLink Designer Program, except that we split the Floral / Nature / Animal category into Floral / Nature and Animal.
The categories are Medieval / Castle, Vehicle / Boat / Airplane, Train, Space / Sci-Fi / Fantasy, Art / Object, Building, Floral / Nature, Animal, Pirate, and History / Period.
See Figs. 1 and 4 for prompt samples by setting.
The prompts were constructed through prompting of an LLM and were manually validated for conformity.
Prompts average 31 words in Alt-Build , 45 in Model , and 57 in Set .
blocks.zh:
每个评价设置有100个提示,10个专题类别各有10个提示。
他们遵循了"BrickLink Designer"方案,只是我们把"花"/"自然"/"动物"分类分为"花"/"自然"和"动物".
分为中世纪/城堡,车辆/船/飞机,列车,航天/科-Fi/幻想,艺术/对象,建筑,花生/自然,动物,海盗,和历史/时期.
见法相. 1和4通过设定快速采样.
提示是通过提示LLM构建的,经过人工验证符合性.
Alt-Build中平均提示31个字,Model中提示45个字,Set中提示57个字。

blocks.en:
We decompose each generation prompt into a question graph in the style of DSG ( Cho et al., 2024 ) , which evaluates text-to-image generation by turning a prompt into atomic yes/no questions with an LLM and answering them with a VLM after organizing them by graph dependency.
The questions cover the entities named by the prompt, their attributes, and the relations among them.
With the graph we can avoid evaluating properties invalidated by other failures, such as checking the color of a knight’s armor when the presence of a knight was not yet established.
See Fig. A1 for their distribution by type and Fig. A2 for a full example graph, both in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
我们分解出每一代的提示为DSG(Cho et al., 2024)风格的提问图,通过用LLM将提示变为原子是/否的问题,并在通过图依赖性组织后用VLM来回答,来评价文本到图像生成.
这些问题包括由提示所命名的实体、其属性以及它们之间的关系。
通过图表,我们可以避免评估因其他失败而失效的属性,例如当骑士的存在尚未确定时检查骑士盔甲的颜色.
见法相. A1按类型和Fig分布. 附录A中的A2作为完整的示例图。

blocks.en: 4.3 BrickAgent
blocks.zh: 4.3 砖矿代理公司

blocks.en:
We introduce BrickAgent, an environment in which the agents build.
It contains the LDraw library, the BrickNet connector system, and tools for authoring, validating, and viewing an assembly programmatically.
The tools include functions to search the library for parts, to place parts by their positions or by connectors, to mirror and measure them, to define subassemblies and combine them, and to render an assembly from any viewpoint.
The provided validator includes the connectivity, collision, and stability tests of Sec. 3.2 and interpretably reports each failure with the parts involved.
This enables an agent to validate the physical requirements of an assembly prior to submission.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍BrickAgent, 一种由Agent建立的环境。
它包含 LDraw 库, BrickNet 连接器系统, 以及用于编译, 校验, 以及按程序查看集合的工具.
这些工具包括搜索库部件、按部件的位置或连接器放置部件、镜像和测量部件、定义子组装和组合部件以及从任何角度制作组件等功能。
提供的校验器包括第3.2条的连通性、相撞性和稳定性测试,并解释每一次故障都与所涉部件一起报告。
这使代理人能够在提交之前验证装配的实际要求。

blocks.en:
The prompt explains the environment with worked examples and states the setting’s part requirements.
It informs the agent that experienced LEGO designers will judge the assembly against others by the standards of a published set.
In the ablation of Sec. 5.2 the agent operates in the same container, with the harness CLI, LDraw library, and task requirements, but without the tools of BrickAgent.
We find that without these tools, frontier coding agents cannot reliably construct valid builds.
blocks.zh:
即时电讯以实例解释环境,
它通知代理人,有经验的LEGO设计师会按照出版的一套标准对集会进行比对.
在Sec 5.2的通缩中,代理在同一个容器中运行,拥有被套取的CLI,LDraw库,以及任务要求,但没有BrickAgent的工具.
我们发现没有这些工具,边界编码剂就无法可靠地建造有效的建筑。

blocks.en: 4.4 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.4 计量

blocks.en:
We score each system per setting, and additionally aggregate across all three ( Overall ).
An assembly is judged as valid if it meets the part requirements of its setting and is both collision-free and stable under the tests of Sec. 3.2 . Valid is a proportion and is scored on every prompt.
blocks.zh:
每个系统都得分,所有三个系统都得分(总体)。
如果组装符合其设定的部分要求,且在3.2.节的试验下既无相撞又稳定,则判定其有效。 有效性是一个比例,在每个提示上都得分。

blocks.en:
VQA measures bounded semantic alignment with the prompt, following DSG.
We render the assembly from eight views using BrickNet’s renderer, with consistent render settings.
We then ask Gemma 4 31B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) each question of the graph in one call, with instructions to judge on what the views show and to answer yes or no.
The score of an assembly is the fraction of its questions satisfied, and VQA is the mean over assemblies.
blocks.zh:
VQA量度受限语义与即时相接,跟随DSG.
我们使用 BrickNet 的渲染器, 用一致的渲染设置,
然后我们用一个电话询问Gemma 4 31B(Gemma Team,2026年)每个图表的问题,并指示判断观点显示的内容,回答是或否.
一个集合的分数是它的问题满足的分数,而VQA则是对集合的恶性.

blocks.en:
ELO measures relative semantic alignment and design quality against other systems.
For each prompt, we form every pairing of assemblies from different systems and show the judge four views of each.
We ask two questions of each pair:
1) The alignment question gives the judge the prompt and asks which assembly matches it better.
2) The design question withholds the prompt and asks which assembly is better designed by the standard of an official set, judged on how the pieces are used rather than the subject.
Each pair is asked in both orderings to eliminate position bias. Fig. A3 in Appendix B contains the judge prompts.
We fit a Bradley–Terry model ( Bradley & Terry, 1952 ) to the wins from each question and report them as ELO.
We anchor to a fixed set of references as noted in Sec. 5 . ELO is the average of Align ELO and Design ELO after rescaling to a common spread over the anchors.
blocks.zh:
ELO对照其他系统衡量相对语义的对接和设计质量.
对于每个快件,我们组成 从不同系统的每一对集会, 并向法官展示每一个的四点观点。
我们每对问两个问题:
1) 校正问题给予法官及时性,并询问哪个组装更符合.
2)设计问题不及时,并询问哪个组装更符合一个正版集的标准,根据棋子的使用方式而不是主体来判断.
每对在两种命令中都被要求消除位置偏差. 附录A3图 B包含法官提示。
Bradley – Terry 型号(Bradley & Terry, 1952)适合每个题的取胜,并报告为ELO.
如第5节所指出,我们依靠的是一套固定的参考文献。 ELO是Align ELO和Design ELO在调整为分布于锚地上的共同后的平均.

blocks.en:
VQA and ELO are scored on the assemblies generated by a system, without considering whether they are Valid . Cost is the list price of the tokens consumed by a system for an assembly in US dollars.
For the two trained baselines it is the serving cost per assembly, at serverless token rates for the base model of BrickNet and as wall-clock time on a rented GPU instance for BrickGPT.
blocks.zh:
VQA和ELO在系统产生的组件上被打分,而不考虑它们是否有效。 成本是指以美元组装的系统所消耗的代币的列表价格.
对于两个经过培训的基线来说,这是每个组装的服务费用,按BrickNet基准模型的无服务器代号费率计算,作为BrickGPT租用的GPU实例的上行时间。

blocks.zh: 5 评价

We evaluate eleven agents and two data-driven baselines.
The agents include GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Qwen 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, and Muse Spark 1.3.

Each agent is given a budget of 300 turns per prompt.
The baselines evaluated are BrickNet-14B ( Kulits & Schmid, 2026 ) and BrickGPT ( Pun et al., 2025 ) , both restricted to the Model setting which is the only one applicable.
Nine of the agents form the reference set of the ELO scale ( Sec. 4.4 ).
The baselines and ablated runs of Sec. 5.2 are rated against them and do not affect the scale.
Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol were released after the human studies of Secs. 5.3 and 5.4 were run, so they are scored on the automated metrics only.
Like the baselines, they are rated against the reference set, which leaves every other rating unchanged, and both fall within the range of ratings on which the judge is validated.

We observe that validity is nearly solved when provided the environment.
Five agents deliver a valid assembly for each prompt and none fall below a Valid proportion of 0.80 overall.

blocks.en:
VQA separates the reference set gently, from 0.59 for GLM to 0.95 for Astra. Design ELO does so more sharply, with 545 ELO points between GLM and Astra, a gap that can be interpreted as a judge preferring Astra’s assembly in around 96% of pairs.
Within the reference set, Astra leads on every metric, and Opus 5 is ranked second while incurring four times the cost.
Sol, Gemini, Qwen, and DeepSeek form a middle within 41 ELO points of one another.
Of the two later agents, GPT-6.1 Sol matches Astra on ELO (1293 against 1297, intervals overlapping) at a fifth of its cost, and Opus 5.5 rates 148 points above Opus 5 at 40% of its cost, inside Astra’s interval on Design ELO but 83 points lower on Align ELO .
Alignment varies more with the kind of question than with the subject ( Fig. A7 in Appendix C ).
No prompt category is consistently harder than the others, and the two top agents score at least 0.90 in every one.
Every agent satisfies at least 91% of the questions about color, but texture is satisfied 49–83% of the time, and object type and state are the next hardest.
The stronger agents also build larger and more varied assemblies ( Tab. A1 in Appendix C ).
In Model , Astra averages 217 parts of 35 types in 9 colors, and GLM 27 parts of 10 types in 5 colors.
In Set , Qwen, DeepSeek, Muse, and GLM average 23 to 40 connected components per assembly, against 2.2 to 4.2 for Astra and both Sol and Opus models, so their scenes consist of far more disconnected pieces. Figs. A4 and A5 in Appendix C plot Tabs. 1 and A1 by setting.

blocks.en:
The reference set spans a factor of 30 in cost, and rank does not follow price.
Muse, for instance, costs nine times what DeepSeek costs and rates 138 points lower.
See Fig. 5(a) for a plot of ELO against Cost .
While Align ELO and Design ELO agree for most agents, Sol scores 53 points higher on alignment than design.
Both trained baselines fall drastically below every agent.
BrickNet-14B is collision-free on only 26% of prompts, while BrickGPT, though valid on each prompt, satisfies 2% of the questions.
See Fig. 4 for sample visuals, and Fig. A6 in Appendix C for ten more prompts.
We observe that the settings differ in what breaks.
In terms of validity, Set is the hardest, with validity dropping to 0.68 for Muse, 0.79 for Qwen, and 0.87 for DeepSeek.
Alignment falls for every agent, and part counts crowd the 400-part floor ( Fig. A8 in Appendix C ), so many agents build the smallest scene allowed by the setting. Alt-Build costs the least and maintains the highest validity.
Alignment is highest in Model , the only setting in which the baselines apply.
blocks.zh:
参考数据集成本为30倍,排名不随价格而行.
例如,Muse的成本是DeepSeek成本的9倍,并降低138分。
见图5(a),关于ELO对成本的阴谋。

While both agents consistently produce valid assemblies when given tools, they struggle without them to varying degrees: GPT-6 Astra is somewhat robust but its assemblies drop to being valid only 40% of the time while GPT-5.6 Luna’s fall to less than a percent.
The environment improves the VQA of Astra but lowers its ELO within noise.

We ablate the BrickAgent environment in Tab. 2 , with the same agent CLI (Codex CLI), container, and task requirements, but with only the LDraw library and a primer on the LDraw file format in place of its tools.
Astra remains valid on 40% of prompts while Luna produces only one valid build in 300.
Their assemblies average 7 and 156 colliding pairs, respectively, and fall apart into 6 and 83 connected components against 2 and 5 with the environment.

blocks.en:
Alignment and design do not fail, however.
Astra’s VQA drops by 0.01 and its ELO moves within the interval.
Both of Luna’s metrics rise, by 0.02 in VQA and by 62 ELO points.
Without the restriction of buildability, Luna makes assemblies that depict the prompt as well and look better, but that cannot be built, demonstrating the importance of relevant verifiers.
Doing so costs Astra nothing on alignment or design, but costs Luna a little of both.

blocks.en: 5.3 Validation of the Design Judge
blocks.zh: 5.3 鉴定设计法官

blocks.en:
To confirm the validity of Design ELO , which rests on a VLM judge, we evaluate against human ratings.
We recruit participants on Prolific and show each 40 pairs of same-prompt assemblies, with four views per assembly.
We collect 4,080 judgments from 102 raters.
We fit the human judgments with the same Bradley–Terry model as ELO ( Sec. 4.4 ), and compare the ratings against Design ELO in Fig. 5(b) .
The rankings agree on 34 of the 36 pairs among the agents, with a Kendall τ \tau of 0.89.
This follows findings from prior work which demonstrated alignment between VLM and human preferences on text-to-3D generation ( Wu et al., 2024 ) .
The judge is more decisive than the rater pool, so we align the two by a constant factor.
Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol were released after this study and are not part of it.

We asked people familiar with LEGO design to tell agent builds from human ones ( Fig. 6 ).
For assemblies in the Model and Set settings, we drew part-count-matched human-designed models from the BrickNet dataset, and asked which of the two a person made.
The drawn samples are not prompt-matched.

A prompt-matched comparison would require commissioning designs, which we leave to future work.
As in Sec. 5.3 , the study predates Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol.
Five raters provided 360 ratings altogether, and selected the human model in 323 of them.
No agent was taken for a human designer more than one time in five ( Fig. 6(a) ), and every agent’s rate falls significantly below chance.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
We report four findings from our evaluations.
First, we find that data-driven models built for the task are subsumed by general agents.
A general coding agent exceeds models on their own benchmark ( Sec. 3.3 ) and on ours.
Cost, however, remains an axis for future work.
BrickNet-14B produces an assembly for six hundredths of a cent, while the Astra does so in $4.06.
Second, prompt adherence saturates.
The best-performing agent satisfies 95% of the VQA questions asked of it, and absolute alignment does not strongly separate the top performers.
Headroom lies instead in design quality.
Third, agent performance is dependent on the environment.
The same model produces consistently buildable assemblies with BrickAgent, and unbuildable ones without it ( Tab. 2 ).
Fourth, a gap remains to humans.
Participants familiar with LEGO design filtered agent-designed assemblies from human ones nine out of ten times ( Fig. 6 ).
We interpret this as a measure of design quality: agents satisfy requirements but fall short of the standards of a designed set.
blocks.zh:
我们报告我们评价的四项结果。
第一,我们发现,为这项任务所建立的数据驱动模型由一般代理人组成。
一般编码剂在自己的基准(第3.3节)和我们的基准上超过模型。
然而,费用仍然是今后工作的轴心。
BrickNet-14B生产了600分一分钱的组装,而Astra则以4.06美元完成.
第二,迅速遵守饱和。
表现最好的代理满足了95%的VQA对其提出的问题,而绝对对接并没有强烈区分出表现最好的代理.
头室则在于设计质量。
第三,代理性能取决于环境.
同一型号与BrickAgent公司生产一致可建造的组件,而没有BrickAgent公司生产无法建造的组件(Tab. 2 )。
第四,人类仍然有差距。
熟悉LEGO设计过滤剂设计的来自人类十分之九的组件的参与者(图6)。
我们将此解释为设计质量的衡量标准:物剂满足要求,但达不到设计设备的标准。

blocks.en:
Our simulator of physical validity is a proxy and not a complete measure of structural stability.
Connections are not tested for strength, so an assembly that balances passes even when a physical one might sag or come apart ( Sec. 3.2 ).
Some works exist that attempt to build force models over stud connections Waßmann & Weicker (2012) to evaluate FEM ( Pletz & Drvoderic, 2023 ) .
None, however, is general, and integrating such would severely limit the available part catalog.
Until a general one exists, our bar for physical evaluation is necessary but not sufficient.
blocks.zh:
我们的物理有效性模拟器是一种代用,而不是结构稳定性的完全度量.
连接不测试强度,所以即使物理连接可能发生分裂,平衡的集合也会通过(第3.2节)。
有些作品试图在马刺连接Waßmann & Weicker(2012年)之上构建出力量模型,以评价FEM(Pletz & Drvoderic,2023年).
但是,没有一种是一般性的,如果将这种内容纳入其中,将严重限制现有的部分目录。
在一般性评估存在之前,我们禁止进行实物评估是必要的,但还不够。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced BrickBench, a benchmark for agentic text-conditioned LEGO-set design.
The domain gives the task a floor that a simulator can verify and an open ceiling on design quality.
It includes 300 prompts in three settings with different constraints, a reference environment in which agents build, BrickAgent, and a set of metrics that score build validity, alignment, and design confirmed by human raters.
Nine frontier agents build valid assemblies for most prompts and satisfy the majority of what each requests, displacing task-specific data-driven models at an increase of 900–6,800 times the cost.
While doing so, we highlight the open challenge of narrowing the gap to human design.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了Brick Bench, 代理文本条件LEGO设定设计的基准.
域名为任务提供了模拟器可以验证的下限,并对设计质量设置了开放的上限.
它包括了在三种不同约束的环境下的300个提示,一种代理构建,BrickAgent的参考环境,以及一套得分建立有效性,校正,和被人类评分者确认的设计.
九名边境特工为大多数快件建立有效组件,满足大多数要求,取代了特定任务的数据驱动模型,成本增加900至6 800倍。
在这样做的同时,我们强调缩小人类设计差距的公开挑战。
